resources.string: AI swipe assistant
Swipe words or a whole sentence without lifting, then choose an AI interpretation
Suggest message continuations
Offer a short continuation as well as a corrected word. Nothing is inserted until you tap.

Enable cloud-assisted swiping?

After a swipe, up to 256 characters of your current draft, local word candidates, keyboard language and, in sentence mode, your gesture path with relative timing and keyboard layout are sent to Google through Firebase AI Logic. This includes text you have not sent. It does not read conversations, notifications or your clipboard.

AI can be wrong. Review suggestions before tapping; sentence choices open a full preview before Insert. Long-press word suggestions to read them. Undo is available until the next edit. Password and specialized fields, incognito mode, no-learning fields and the lock screen are excluded, but sensitive information in ordinary messages cannot always be detected.

Network and provider charges may apply. Turn this switch off to stop new requests. Permission is not restored from a settings backup.

This feature needs a cloud-enabled build with Firebase Android app configuration, working App Check. Sentence mode reads gestures directly; normal word glide still needs the separately installed glide library. Follow docs/AI_SWIPE.md in this fork. Normal typing remains available without AI.
